local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
sky.Name = "AnimatedSky"
sky.Parent = game.Lighting

while true do
    for _, id in ipairs(imageIds) do
        local url = "rbxassetid://" .. id
        sky.SkyboxBk = url
        sky.SkyboxDn = url
        sky.SkyboxFt = url
        sky.SkyboxLf = url
        sky.SkyboxRt = url
        sky.SkyboxUp = url
        task.wait(0.3)

end
